page_title: RAY 1-0 ESP | Rayo Vallecano v Espanyol 23/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Adrian Cordero has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+6' What a chance that is! Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
90+4' Nice passing game by Espanyol. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Pere Milla goes off and Miguel Rubio (Espanyol) comes on.
90+1' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Dani Cardenas easily catches the ball.

87' 1 - 0 Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Marko Dmitrovic is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
86' There's an opportunity for Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
86' Exposito (Espanyol) sends a long ball in, but Dani Cardenas comfortably gathers the ball.
84' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
84' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Marko Dmitrovic (Espanyol).
83' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) receives a yellow card for infringement.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch so that Pedro Diaz can be given a rest.
81' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Jozhua Vertrouwd will be replaced by Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano).

79' What a miss! The corner finds Pere Milla (Espanyol) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
79' The linesman points to the corner flag, Espanyol are going to take it.
78' Substitution. Tyrhys Dolan makes his way off the pitch and Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) comes on as his replacement.
78' Substitution. Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) has come on for Fernando Calero.
76' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Oscar Valentin.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alemao trots off the pitch and is replaced by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
75' It's like he was asking for a caution. Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) receives a yellow card.
74' Espanyol force their opponents to concede a corner.

74' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up sends the ball to the left side of the target, but Dani Cardenas keeps his cool to thwart him.
74' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
73' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano). Espanyol are awarded a penalty kick!

73' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
72' Exposito (Espanyol) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

70' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Marko Dmitrovic pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

69' Great chance! Kike Garcia (Espanyol) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
67' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Roberto Fernandez Jaen and he is replaced by Ramon Terrats (Espanyol).

67' He should have scored! Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Dani Cardenas makes an easy save.
66' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes.
65' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
63' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
63' Ilias Akhomach (Rayo Vallecano) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
63' Rayo Vallecano control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

60' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
60' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

59' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Marko Dmitrovic was alert and the score remained the same.
59' Rayo Vallecano hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
58' The game has come to an end for Pacha. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ilias Akhomach (Rayo Vallecano).
55' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

53' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Marko Dmitrovic, who pulls off a comfortable save!
50' Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
49' Rayo Vallecano are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

43' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 7:9.

39' The Espanyol players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
37' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom right corner, but Marko Dmitrovic is prepared and dives to thwart him.
35' Although Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is just on the bench, Adrian Cordero has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
32' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
31' Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
31' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes.
29' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off the line to clear the ball away.

27' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
26' The Espanyol players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 48:52.
23' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.
21' The corner by Exposito (Espanyol) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
21' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
19' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
18' Espanyol enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Espanyol.
15' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
14' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
12' Espanyol take a short corner kick.

11' Exposito (Espanyol) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
9' Espanyol are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
8' Great teamplay by Rayo Vallecano as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
3' That's a free kick to Rayo Vallecano.
